title: Empanadas with Date Filling
description: A delicious Venezuelan-inspired dessert, featuring sweet empanadas filled with a date-based filling.
instructions: Make or thaw the pastry dough according to package instructions.
In a bowl, mix together the crumbled cheese, melted butter, cinnamon, sugar, and salt.
Add the pitted dates to the cheese mixture and mix well.
Roll out the pastry dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of the date mixture in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape, and press the edges to seal.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with a little water and sprinkle with sugar.
Bake the empanadas in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
